headline: Unisys Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Guidance
summary: Unisys announced third-quarter 2026 revenue of $471.5 million, marking a 2.5% year-over-year increase, and raised its full-year revenue guidance amid continued strong new business signings.
why: Unisys is a global information technology solutions company. Quarterly earnings and revenue guidance revisions provide key insights into enterprise IT spending trends and corporate financial health.
